decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: The parenthetical identifies a direct score comparison: (0.091−0.085)/0.085 = 7.1%. Thus “gain” denotes Thimble’s relative advantage over the debiased variant, not each model’s gain over uniform sampling (T1.r2.tail, T1.r3.tail).

decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: Thimble adds a session-aware encoder beyond debiased sampling and has higher tail Recall@20 than the sampling-only variant. “May contribute” appropriately presents this as a possibility rather than an established causal effect (Methods summary; T1.r2.tail, T1.r3.tail).

decisions.label: NOT_VERIFIABLE
decisions.rationale: The package verifies that exp1 uses one dataset, Garnet-Retail, but “should be interpreted cautiously” is an interpretive recommendation rather than a factual proposition whose truth the package can entail (exp1).
